bounded_change.description: Add one proposed RFC, a machine-readable contract, deterministic scenarios, and mutation tests; do not change the live public surface or unrelated global reader rubrics.

regression_guards: No private transcript, correspondence, relationship source, negotiation, repository locator, or private graph topology enters the public candidate.
The proposed unit is a fixed-fee outcome, not an hourly-labor listing.
The working session can stand alone and any follow-on requires separate scope and authorization.
The inquiry does not imply booking, present availability, a signed agreement, or publication authority.
The existing public page remains unchanged until Jamie accepts the RFC and approves exact implementation copy.
